title: Fix MinecraftAdapter double-connect orphaned processes (P0 audit)
description: P0 finding from 2026-07-11 audit: MinecraftAdapter.ConnectAsync has no guard against existing connection. If called twice, _nodeProcess and _bridge are replaced without disposing the previous instances. Orphaned Node.js processes accumulate. Also, Dispose doesn't call DisconnectAsync. Add guard + ensure cleanup. Source: Data/Pages/Audits/codebase-audit-20260711-10agent-swarm-5chair-council.md (P0-003)
